answer: We formulate dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect punishment matrices to neutralize identity multiplication, modulating every pulse to enforce strict penalization. Capital barrier analysis proves the expected payoff of Sybil expansion is strictly negative, turning the adversarial landscape into a barren meadow where illicit funds depreciate. Thus, Nash equilibrium converges in adversarial environments, since a jade collateral threshold deters deviation, ensuring Sybil resistance.
